about: One real in vitro recording for each of the 11 electrical types (e-types) of Markram et al. (2015), Cell 163:456: whole-cell current clamp in slices of the rat's somatosensory cortex, the response to a 2 s step of current (IDRest) from 150 to 2150 ms, chosen as the weakest step giving about 20 spikes (the stuttering cell's for its stutter). Voltage in mV as [min, max] pairs per 1 ms bin, rounded. The ten interneurons recorded by Maria Toledo-Rodriguez (2000-01), the pyramidal cell by Sandrine Romand (2006, P14, hindlimb area), Markram lab, EPFL; from the Open Brain Institute's EntityCore.
